title: Quantifying Deep Learning Model Uncertainty in Conformal Prediction
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical quantification of model uncertainty in deep learning, particularly for medical AI applications, to enable more reliable and informed decision-making. While the application in medical AI touches upon ethical considerations regarding patient care and risks, the paper itself does not evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical frameworks. It aims to provide a technical tool to support better decisions, which in turn can contribute to ethical practice.
